title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: The word that was missing from the list
summary: A run of const val lines read as one declaration spread over six lines, so every unused constant showed a diagnostic with no quick fix behind it.

highlights.title: Unused constants can be removed again
highlights.description: The list of words that open a declaration was missing const, so a companion object read as a single declaration and its extent was refused. On a real 6329 source project, 58 of the 66 findings offered without a fix were exactly that.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: A block of constants had no removal at all: `const` was absent from the list of words that open a declaration, so a run of `const val` lines read as ONE declaration spanning them all and the extent was refused.
The same list was missing `lateinit`, `final`, `static`, `inner`, `annotation`, `value`, `external`, `expect`, `actual`, `operator`, `infix` and `tailrec`.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Every cut was compared on 6329 real sources before and after: no existing cut moved, 58 appeared, and the 8 refusals left are declarations whose body starts on the following line.
Removable class members go from 257 to 313, unreferenced symbols from 95 to 97 out of 98.
